description: Send an email from this inbox's own @getcourier.dev address. Free: up to 100 recipients a month, reply-only (only to people who emailed this inbox, or to the verified owner), because spam bots abuse free email senders. To send to anyone: pass an account_key with credits (20 credits = $0.002 per recipient), pay per call with x402 (retry with _meta["x402/payment"]; USDC on Base, minimum $0.01, unused part kept as credit), or verify a human owner with verify_owner. Caps: 50 different recipients per inbox per day. Never send unsolicited or bulk mail. Next: call wait_for_code or list_messages to read the reply.

account_key.description: Pay from this account instead of the inbox owner. Optional.

attachments.description: Files to attach (paid: +10 credits per recipient per MB; never free). MCP requests are capped at 64 KB, so attach larger files with REST POST /v1/sandbox/inboxes/{alias}/send (up to 7 MB total).

content_type.description: MIME type. Optional; guessed from the extension.

in_reply_to.description: The <message-id> you are replying to. Optional.

read_token.description: The read_token returned by create_inbox (or send it as Authorization: Bearer).

to.description: Recipient email addresses (1-50 together with cc).

name: send_message
title: Send email
